page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a full-width dedication title in large type over four centred lines, then a greeting line, then the body of the dedication in one column with a woodcut initial at its start. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword. At the lower left, the gathering signature.

main_text.l: SERENISS° POTEN-
TISSIMOQUE PRINCIPI, AC DOMINO
NOSTRO, Iacobo, Dei Gratia, Magnæ
Britanniæ, Franciæ & Hiberniæ Regi,
FIDEI Defensori &c.
SERENISSIME POTENTISSIMEQ; REX,
Quod pro suo iure Rex quivis fa-
ceret, ut Suorum animos, qui iu-
stam suspicioni causam dederant,
nova Iuramenti religione explo-
ratos Sibi redderet: cum causa Matti[?] T.[?]
subesset iustissima, ex Scelere post homines natos a-
trocissimo, & id nuper facere tentares: interce-
ssum est a Papa Paulo, atque incursio facta in Ius
Tuum, nec Tuum modo, sed commune Ius
Regum omnium. Ea enim in Te unum experrecta
jam, mox & in reliquos omnes convalescet.
Agitur ergo communis Regum causa; cumque in
Regibus, Rei Christianae praesidij plurimum sit,
cum Illis, communis etiam Rei totius Christianae.
Iam, ubi in discrimen adducta causa Commu-
nitatis, Spectator nemo fit, Actor quisque: Ex com-
munis enim Officij nexu, cuiusuis tum interest de
Communitate, communis Militiae Sacramento
obligare se statim: & ubi res omnium agitur,

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorative Q; the text after it reads "uod", joined as "Quod". The reference "Matti. T." is a superscript abbreviation whose exact letters are uncertain. A small "1" printed beside "SERENISS°" in the title was left out as a printer's mark. No marginal notes are printed on this page. The signature "A 2" stands at the foot as the gathering mark; no separate page number is printed.
